:root{--brand:#3f3e95;--sun:#ebad18;--ink:#1e1e1c;--paper:#fff}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%;width:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#18192e;color:#fff}
body{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;margin:0!important;padding:0!important}
header{position:relative;z-index:10;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px 18px 11px 20px;background:#26284e;border-bottom:2px solid #ebad18;height:65px;box-shadow:0 3px 17px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.logo-mini{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-width:0}
.logo-mark{display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:9px;background:#ebad18;color:#18192e;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;padding:8px 11px}
.header-title{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.15;min-width:0}
.header-title b{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.15px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.header-title small{color:#bbbfe8;font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}
.top-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
button{color:inherit;cursor:pointer;background:#ffffff12;border:1px solid #ffffff35;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 13px;font-weight:650;touch-action:manipulation;transition:background .15s ease}
button:hover{background:#ffffff26}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--sun);outline-offset:3px}
button:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
button.primary{background:#ebad18;color:#16162d;border-color:#ebad18}
#viewport{width:100%;height:calc(100dvh - 129px);min-height:350px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,#3d405b 0%,#282a43 60%,#151726 100%)}
#viewport::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.12;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0px,transparent 39px,#fff1 40px,transparent 41px)}
#stage{position:relative;width:1191px;height:842px;flex:none;transform-origin:center center;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 15px #0006)}
#book{position:absolute;inset:0;perspective:2600px;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.paper-shell{position:absolute;top:0;width:595.3px;height:841.9px;background:#f6f4ef;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(35,28,15,.12)}
.paper-shell.left{left:0;box-shadow:-7px 1px 30px #05040c5e,inset -13px 0 20px #00000009}
.paper-shell.right{left:595.3px;box-shadow:7px 1px 30px #05040c5e,inset 13px 0 20px #0000000e}
#spine{position:absolute;left:593px;top:0;width:6px;height:842px;z-index:10;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0004,#fff2,#0005);opacity:.5}
#book .page{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;margin:0!important;page-break-after:auto!important;break-after:auto!important;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
.blank{width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#efedeb,#faf8f5)}
.leaf{position:absolute;top:0;left:595.3px;width:595.3px;height:841.9px;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform-origin:left center;z-index:12;will-change:transform}
.leaf.prev{left:0;transform-origin:right center}
.face{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.face.back{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.leaf.go{transition:transform .78s cubic-bezier(.28,.04,.15,1);transform:rotateY(-180deg)}
.leaf.prev.go{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.leaf .face::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:inset -12px 0 25px #00000021}
.leaf.prev .face::after{box-shadow:inset 12px 0 25px #00000021}
#corner-right,#corner-left{z-index:11;position:absolute;top:0;width:75px;height:100%;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:0;opacity:.001}
#corner-left{left:0}#corner-right{right:0}
#corner-left:hover,#corner-right:hover{opacity:.13;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ebad18,transparent)}
#corner-right:hover{background:linear-gradient(270deg,#ebad18,transparent)}
footer{height:64px;position:relative;z-index:10;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:7px 17px;background:#26284e;border-top:1px solid #ffffff1e}
.controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
#count{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#ecedf8;min-width:105px;text-align:center;font-size:13px}
#range{accent-color:#ebad18;width:clamp(85px,26vw,325px);cursor:pointer}
#hint{font-size:11px;color:#d1d1e6}
.chip{font-size:11px;border:1px solid #ffffff2a;border-radius:30px;padding:4px 10px;color:#dadaea}
#page-store{display:none}

#zoom-scroll{flex:1;overflow:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:24px}
#zoom-paper{flex:none;width:595.3px;height:841.9px;background:#fff;position:relative;box-shadow:0 9px 30px #0009}
#zoom-paper .page{margin:0;position:absolute;left:0;top:0}
@media(max-width:690px){#zoom-scroll{justify-content:flex-start;padding:12px}}
.mobile-instr{display:none}
@media(max-width:800px){header{height:59px;padding:8px 12px} .header-title b{font-size:13px}.header-title small{font-size:10px}.top-actions button:nth-child(1){display:none}#viewport{height:calc(100dvh - 119px)}#hint,.chip{display:none}footer{height:60px;padding:7px 12px} #count{min-width:75px;font-size:12px}#range{width:95px}.controls button{padding:7px 11px}.mobile-instr{display:block;position:absolute;z-index:9;bottom:10px;color:#eeefffd4;font-size:11px;text-align:center;width:100%;pointer-events:none} }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.leaf.go{transition-duration:.06s}}
